scope:
Isolated authority protocol against the pinned image's real filesystem/tools.

Includes helper SIGKILL around registry rename. Does not start PostgreSQL or test
reload, host journals, power loss or whole-operation recovery.
checks: revoked operation cannot freshly prepare authority
new active operation publishes exact content
SIGKILL before registry rename preserves active version
SIGKILL after registry rename preserves revoked version
dead helper releases lock for a new exact operation
